about: The emulated deck (pi-qemu): a virtual trimixxx2, so its controls land where trimixxx2's do -- the eighth pad third in ring A, hot cues 1-4 reversed, the jog the other way round -- and the remap is exercised before a real deck sees it. Its own accent, cyan, so it is never mistaken for trimixxx2 on a screenshot. No bezel: the emulator's screen has no lip. Applied by upload.sh through apply.py; see ../README.md.
